newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY CENBANK BASE RATE TO 21.50 PCT FROM 22.50.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY CENBANK BASE RATE TO 21.50 PCT FROM 22.50.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Wednesday that it would reduce the base rate to an annual 21.50 percent from the current annual 22.50 percent from March 1.

"Moderating inflation, favourable trends so far in the current account and in the budget, and continuously declining interest rates on the money and capital markets made the reduction of base rate possible," the NBH said in a statement.

The NBH said that interest rate on refinancing loans of over one-year maturity, provided to financial institutions, as well as forint interest rates on project financing loans, given on the collateral of hard currency deposits, are also being reduced to an annual 21.50 percent from 22.50 percent.
The interest rate on the so-called Start and Japanese refinancing loans -- which are always 75 percent of the base rate -- is reduced to an annual 16.125 percent from 16.875 percent.
The central bank left its other rates unchanged.
